sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUJIT NARAYAN PRASAD HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY PRASAD

For the Appellant : Mr. Nilesh Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Anil Kumar, A.S.G.I. : Ms.
Chandana Kumari, Advocate ------
Order No. 10/Dated 6th August, 2025 I.A. No.5716 of 2025 1.

This interlocutory application has been filed under Section 430 of B.N.S.S., 2023 for suspension of sentence dated 31.08.2024 passed by learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-X, Ranchi, in connection with N.D.P.S. Case No.01 of 2015 (N) whereby and whereunder, the appellant has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment of 20 years and fine of Rs.10,000/- for the offence under Section 376 D of the I.P.C. and under Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and in default of payment of the fine, S.I. for six months.
2.
After some argument, learned counsel appearing for the appellant has submitted that he does not intend to press the instant interlocutory application.
3. Considering the submission made on behalf of the appellant, the instant interlocutory application being I.A. No.5716 of 2025 is dismissed as not pressed, accordingly disposed of.

(Sujit Narayan Prasad, J.) (Sanjay Prasad, J.) Birendra/
